disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件全部代码与配置（host 半边、浏览器半边、挂载配置、脚本），未发现读取凭据文件、环境变量密钥、云凭据或钱包助记词的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all plugin code and configuration (host side, browser side, patch config, scripts); no code path was found that reads credential files, environment variable secrets, cloud credentials, or wallet mnemonics.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对敏感路径（凭据文件、SSH 密钥、云凭据目录等）的任何访问；唯一的文件读写是 host 半边把皮肤偏好写入 DSH 主目录下的状态文件 dream-skin.json（权限 0600、原子写入），与插件声明的持久化功能一致。
checked_items.en: No access to sensitive paths (credential files, SSH keys, cloud credential directories, etc.) was detected; the only file read/write is the host side writing skin preferences to the state file dream-skin.json in the DSH home directory (permissions 0600, atomic write), consistent with the plugin's declared persistence behavior.

evidence.zh: 未检出读取凭据文件或敏感路径的代码；浏览器半边只访问自身设置存储，host 半边只读写自身状态文件，不存在凭据外泄面。
evidence.en: No code reading credential files or sensitive paths was detected; the browser side only accesses its own settings storage, and the host side only reads/writes its own state file, leaving no credential exfiltration surface.

checked_items.zh: 通读了全部模型可达文本面（README 及多语言翻译、设计文档、技能文件、代码注释），未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、优先级操纵、远程指令加载或审批绕过类措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through all model-reachable text surfaces (README and multilingual translations, design documents, skill files, code comments); no wording was found for instruction override, fake system messages, priority manipulation, remote instruction loading, or approval bypass.

checked_items.zh: 对机械扫描命中的规则 DSH-X10（对应 DG-R2-57）逐条人工裁决：仓库内模型面指令文件（技能文件 SKILL.md）内容是本插件自己的安装引导，明确要求先征得用户确认再执行安装，不含任何注入措辞，判定良性排除。
checked_items.en: For the mechanically flagged rule DSH-X10 (corresponding to DG-R2-57), each hit was manually adjudicated: the in-repo model-facing instruction file (skill file SKILL.md) contains the plugin's own installation guide, explicitly requiring user confirmation before performing installation, with no injection wording; adjudicated as benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 插件运行时不注册任何工具、不注入系统提示片段；README 中可复制给助手的一句话安装文案属用户主动粘贴的市场引导，且最终安装同样走官方命令与用户确认流程。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers no tools at runtime and injects no system prompt fragments; the one-line installation text in the README that users can copy to their assistant is a marketing guide that users actively paste, and the final installation still follows the official command and user confirmation flow.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何工具，也没有向系统提示注入片段；唯一模型面文件是安装技能，内容为引导安装本插件、要求用户确认，无指令覆写或凭证诱导措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools and injects no fragments into the system prompt; the only model-facing file is the installation skill, whose content guides installing this plugin and requires user confirmation, with no instruction override or credential inducement wording.

evidence.zh: 安装引导文案（技能文件与 README）只引导用户通过官方 dsh plugin 命令安装本插件，技能文件明确要求先征得用户确认，未发现诱导静默安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: The installation guide copy (skill file and README) only guides users to install this plugin via the official dsh plugin command; the skill file explicitly requires user confirmation first. No wording inducing silent installation, config rewriting, or privilege expansion was found.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部 YAML/JS 源码与配置：挂载配置仅插入一条普通加载项，全树未发现可执行的 YAML 标量、动态求值（eval/Function）或子进程调用；浏览器半边仅做界面换肤与设置持久化。
checked_items.en: Scanned all YAML/JS source and configs: the patch config only inserts one ordinary load entry; no executable YAML scalar, dynamic evaluation (eval/Function), or subprocess invocation was found in the whole tree; the browser side only does UI skinning and settings persistence.

checked_items.zh: 对机械扫描命中的规则 DSH-X07（对应 DG-R3-59）逐条人工裁决：两个 GitHub 工作流均为仓库自身的工程与维护自动化（一个跑测试和语法检查、一个每日刷新下载量统计图），不在用户机器上执行、不参与插件安装，判定良性排除。
checked_items.en: For the mechanically flagged rule DSH-X07 (corresponding to DG-R3-59), each hit was manually adjudicated: both GitHub workflows are the repo's own engineering and maintenance automation (one runs tests and syntax checks, one refreshes the daily download stats chart); they do not execute on user machines and do not participate in plugin installation; adjudicated as benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 对机械扫描命中的规则 DSH-X05（对应 DG-R3-57）人工裁决：浏览器半边里的剪贴板调用是「主题包分享」按钮把分享链接写入剪贴板，属浏览器标准功能，不是键盘监听或凭据访问，判定良性排除。
checked_items.en: For the mechanically flagged rule DSH-X05 (corresponding to DG-R3-57), manual adjudication: the clipboard call in the browser side is the "theme pack share" button writing a share link to the clipboard; this is a standard browser feature, not keyboard monitoring or credential access; adjudicated as benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 对机械扫描命中的规则 DSH-X08（对应 DG-R3-60）人工裁决：转义密度信号行是壁纸地址校验函数中拒绝控制字符的正则表达式，属安全校验代码而非混淆，判定良性排除。
checked_items.en: For the mechanically flagged rule DSH-X08 (corresponding to DG-R3-60), manual adjudication: the escape-density signal line is a regular expression in the wallpaper address validation function rejecting control characters; it is security validation code, not obfuscation; adjudicated as benign and excluded.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）仅插入一条普通加载项（id 加包名），全树未发现 !!js 之类的 YAML 可执行标量。
evidence.en: The patch config (cordis.patch.yml) only inserts one ordinary load entry (id plus package name); no YAML executable scalar like !!js was found in the whole tree.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用动态代码包工具，也没有把代码交给 node:vm 执行的路径，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not invoke dynamic code packaging tools, nor does it have a path that hands code to node:vm for execution; the scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 包声明无安装钩子脚本；仓库内也没有 git 钩子、devcontainer、Makefile 等执行载体，仅有仓库自身的 CI 工作流（已裁决为良性）。
evidence.en: The package declaration has no install hook script; the repo also contains no git hooks, devcontainer, Makefile, or other execution carriers; only the repo's own CI workflow exists (already adjudicated as benign).

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器半边（dsh.client），会自动加载进 DSH Web 界面；该半边仅做换肤、壁纸、设置持久化等界面操作，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板窃取或调用凭据类特权接口。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser side (dsh.client) that auto-loads into the DSH Web UI; this side only performs UI operations such as skinning, wallpaper, and settings persistence. No keyboard monitoring, clipboard theft, or invocation of credential-class privileged APIs was found.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部网络调用面：浏览器半边的请求仅发往同源自身接口（/dream-skin/api），未发现任何第三方域名、裸 IP、隧道或编码外发通道；插件运行时不读取任何凭据，无外泄数据源。
checked_items.en: Mapped all network call surfaces: the browser side's requests go only to the same-origin self API (/dream-skin/api); no third-party domains, raw IPs, tunnels, or encoded exfiltration channels were found; the plugin reads no credentials at runtime, leaving no source of data for exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 脚本目录的统计采集脚本会请求 npm 与 GitHub 公共 API，但它只供仓库 CI 的统计图维护使用，不在插件发布清单内、不随插件分发，不构成插件运行时的外联面。
checked_items.en: The stats collection script in the script directory requests npm and GitHub public APIs, but it is only used for the repo CI's stats chart maintenance, is not in the plugin release manifest, and is not distributed with the plugin; it does not constitute a runtime outbound connection surface of the plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件运行时无任何对外网络请求：浏览器半边的请求仅发往同源的自身持久化接口，唯一外联是用户主动填写的壁纸图片 URL（用于加载图片），脚本目录的统计采集脚本只在仓库 CI 中运行，不随插件分发。
evidence.en: The plugin makes no outbound network requests at runtime: the browser side's requests go only to the same-origin self persistence API; the only outbound connection is the wallpaper image URL that the user actively fills in (used to load images); the stats collection script in the script directory runs only in repo CI and is not distributed with the plugin.

checked_items.zh: 核对包声明与锁文件：无安装钩子脚本，无未锁定版本的可执行依赖；依赖全部为官方 @deepseek-ai 系列包与 React，未发现仿冒包名或可疑第三方包。
checked_items.en: Checked the package declaration and lock file: no install hook script, no executable dependency with an unlocked version; all dependencies are official @deepseek-ai packages and React; no look-alike package names or suspicious third-party packages were found.

checked_items.zh: 核对挂载配置：仅插入插件自身加载项，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，未禁用任何安全项，也未改写其它插件的服务装配；作者身份无官方认证标记。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config: it only inserts the plugin's own load entry, does not touch security lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not disable any security items, and does not rewrite other plugins' service assembly; the author identity has no official certification mark.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，没有禁用安全项或用环境变量降权的写法。
evidence.en: The patch config does not touch sandbox, approval, permission, or other security lines; there is no pattern of disabling security items or downgrading via environment variables.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何审批或预执行事件的监听，不存在截断审批链的可能。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no listeners for approval or pre-execution events, so there is no possibility of truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较升级自动激活风险。
evidence.en: First-time audit; no previous version baseline exists to compare for upgrade auto-activation risk.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不影响其他插件的服务装配。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite inject/intercept config and does not affect other plugins' service assembly.

checked_items.zh: 审查了插件挂载的运行时表面：host 半边在宿主 Web 服务器上注册了一个自身 API 路由，并实现了与宿主一致的信住围栏（仅回环或受信主机、同源与跨站标记校验、请求体大小限制、仅接受字符串/null 值、错误不外泄内部信息）；宿主 Web 服务本身无认证层属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the plugin's mounted runtime surface: the host side registers a self API route on the host web server and implements a trust fence consistent with the host (loopback or trusted hosts only, same-origin and cross-site marker validation, request body size limits, accepting only string/null values, and not leaking internal information on errors); the host web service itself lacking an authentication layer is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件在宿主 Web 服务器上挂载了一个自身 API 路由（/dream-skin/api），实现了与宿主一致的信住围栏，未另开端口；宿主 Web 服务本身无认证层属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin mounts a self API route (/dream-skin/api) on the host web server, implementing a trust fence consistent with the host, without opening another port; the host web service itself lacking an authentication layer is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 插件身份与元数据核验通过：包名/版本/提交一致，依赖全部为官方 @deepseek-ai 系列包，未发现仿冒命名或可疑作者信号。
summary.en: Plugin identity and metadata verification passed: package name/version/commit are consistent, all dependencies are official @deepseek-ai packages, and no look-alike naming or suspicious author signals were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成（扫描 43 个文件）：命中 5 条规则均已逐条人工裁决为良性，未发现代码执行、凭据窃取、外联等恶意模式。
summary.en: Static scan complete (43 files scanned): all 5 rules hit were manually adjudicated one by one as benign; no malicious patterns such as code execution, credential theft, or outbound connections were found.

summary.zh: 行为面分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感文件读取、无插件自身发起的网络外联。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive file reads, and no network outbound initiated by the plugin itself.

summary.zh: 模型面审查通过：插件不注册工具或系统提示片段；唯一模型面文件（安装技能）内容良性且要求用户确认。
summary.en: Model-face review passed: the plugin registers no tools or system prompt fragments; the only model-facing file (the installation skill) has benign content and requires user confirmation.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态运行产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic runtime artifacts).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态运行产物）；插件声明文件未显式列出能力清单，declared_capabilities 由代码实测推断并在报告中如实填写；文件清单中的图片、统计图与锁文件未逐字通读（非代码面）；壁纸与渐变值会进入界面样式属性，但均为用户自选内容且受样式属性赋值边界约束，未发现可利用的注入路径。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic runtime artifacts); the plugin declaration file does not explicitly list a capability manifest, so declared_capabilities were inferred from actual code inspection and reported faithfully; images, stats charts, and the lock file in the file manifest were not read word-for-word (non-code surfaces); wallpaper and gradient values enter UI style properties, but they are all user-chosen content and constrained by style property assignment boundaries, with no exploitable injection path found.
